title: Assessment questions, answered
description: Still have questions? Reach out and we will walk you through it.

primary.textDescription: Call us with your assessment questions

items.title: How long does a psychological assessment take?
items.content: Most assessments are completed over two to three sessions, depending on the referral question. Each session typically lasts 60 to 90 minutes. We schedule at a pace that works for you.

items.title: What conditions or concerns can an assessment diagnose?
items.content: We assess for ADHD, learning disorders, mood and anxiety conditions, and personality functioning, among other clinical concerns. The specific focus depends on what you and your referring provider want to clarify.

items.title: Do I need a referral from a doctor?
items.content: No. You can schedule directly. That said, some insurance plans may require a referral, so checking with your provider beforehand is a good idea.

items.title: Will my insurance cover the assessment?
items.content: Coverage varies by plan. We recommend calling your insurance company and asking about out-of-network psychological testing benefits. We can provide the documentation you need to submit a claim.

items.title: What do I get at the end of the process?
items.content: You receive a detailed written report with diagnostic findings, test results, and specific recommendations. We also offer a feedback session where we walk through the results and answer your questions.

items.title: Do you work with children and adolescents?
items.content: Yes. We conduct assessments for children, adolescents, and adults. For minors, we involve parents in the intake and feedback process to make sure recommendations fit the family context.
